The philosophy band image, replacing the peptide-field render. Malcolm chose the SKIN8 reclining-sweep brief 'because it shows the face', picked nbp_flash_02 of the six candidates — the fullest profile, eye clearly visible — and confirmed it live: 'this image looks good, lets go with this one'.

Its background is a warm bone grey rather than graphite. He asked for graphite before seeing it in place and confirmed the frame afterwards, so the colour request is superseded for this image.

Cropped from the source 16:9 to the band's 2.4:1, biased slightly above centre so the jaw and lips stay in frame and the throat sweep is not cut.

Produced by nbp_flash (gemini-3.1-flash-image) at $0.02 an image. Over three rounds Seedream refused this subject every time, gpt-image refused most of it, and FLUX.2 refused about half; Luma, NBP Pro and NBP Flash produced every frame Malcolm shortlisted. The six-supplier fan-out is effectively a three-supplier one for bare-skin subjects.
